name: @supasayan/ytm
description: Root package to run both client and server

scripts.start: npx concurrently "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.app:dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npx wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npx wait-on http://localhost:3001 && npx electron ."
scripts.app:build: npm run build --prefix client && npx electron-builder --mac
